rules.name: person_standalone_gerhard

rules.name: organisation_gericht_city
rules.description: Extracts court names including genitive forms, but explicitly excludes person titles (Dr., Mag., etc.) immediately following the court name to prevent over-capture.

rules.name: organisation_it
rules.description: Captures company names ending in 'IT' (e.g., 'Defontaine IT', 'Rosenhagen Cloud') to prevent them from being missed or misclassified.

rules.name: person_hyphenated_after_preposition

rules.name: person_hyphenated_title

rules.name: organisation_gericht_genitive

rules.name: organisation_eu

rules.name: person_rgr_title

rules.name: person_after_legal_role_no_title
rules.description: Captures person names without titles immediately following legal role markers (e.g., 'des Zeugen Manfred Papirnyik', 'der Zeugin Sabine Denisoff'). Requires two capitalized words to distinguish from single-word nouns or cities.

rules.name: person_standalone_no_preposition
rules.description: Captures person names with titles (Dr., Mag., etc.) but explicitly excludes names followed by 'Rechtsanwälte' (law firm suffix) to prevent misclassifying firm names as persons.

rules.name: person_standalone_no_title

rules.name: organisation_gmbh_gesellschaft
rules.description: Extracts company names ending in GmbH/Gesellschaft mbH. Requires at least two distinct name words before the suffix to prevent matching generic terms like 'Systeme GmbH' or 'Garten AG'.

rules.name: organisation_magistrat_wien
